biography.plain_text: John Winter is a New Zealand marine entrepreneur who ran Winter Yachts, combining boat development with commercial charter operations. He worked on design, supervised construction and commissioned vessels for paying guests. As managing director of Adventure Bay Motor Yachts, he later imported and adapted Activa motorboats for the New Zealand market.

long_biography.plain_text:
Marine entrepreneur John Winter paid particular attention to how customers would use and maintain imported boats. For a New Zealand model, he specified opening glass panels above the windscreen to improve ventilation and visibility in wet weather. He also favoured ordinary domestic appliances because they were easier to repair or replace internationally than specialist marine equipment.

Customer requests helped shape the range he offered. Interest in an enclosed upper steering area led to a larger Activa model with more sheltered space. His company customised layouts, while naval designer Max Carter altered the hull to meet demand for higher speeds. The changes included propeller tunnels that avoided relocating the shafts.
